title: Photo scroll story
description: A scroll-driven hero made of two 3D photos (CC0, with estimated depth maps): scrolling the page dives down a blue-hour old-town street (a dolly move driven by the timeline), dissolves into a mountain lake, and ends on a dolly zoom where the mountains swell behind the jetties, with headlines that fade between the chapters (data-bound). Swap the photos and run `assets depth` to tell your own story.
